pages.text: How to obtain: $(bold)Loot chest + Craft$()$(br2)Source: $(bold)Nether Fortress$() chests only. Not Bastion chests, and not Ruined Portal - its loot table isn't Nether-specific, so it was removed.$(br2)Chance: $(bold)30%$() per chest.
Or craft it: a full set of Netherite armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) and Netherite tools (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel) around an Eye of Ender.
